# Use cases

1. **Sector benchmarking** - compare Scope 1 / Scope 2 intensity across the 10 sectors using output_tables.csv and the economic workbook.
2. **Supply-chain exposure** - trace inter-sector flows in input_tables.csv to estimate indirect emissions of a portfolio.
3. **Regulatory reporting** - reuse ESRS S1-6 and E1-6 data points for CSRD disclosures; every row carries source and verification status.
4. **Investor due diligence** - verify the package integrity against the block content hash before relying on any figure.
5. **Secondary market** - token holders can resell shares of the block; accounting memos keep the audit trail of each transfer.
